2608.23565.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
2608.23565.paper_summary: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.
2608.23565.paper_summary_zh: 互動世界模型必須跟隨用戶的行動，記住它所展示的地方，並實時串流。張力是結構性的：控制希望有短期的視野，記憶則希望有無限的視野。ReWorld 在訓練期間將這兩者分開，並在推理時對其進行約束。混合的每頭注意力窗口將大多數頭限制在近期過去，而一小組全局頭則關注整個歷史，隨機頭路由使得任一能力不會綁定於特定的頭；隨機片段丟棄使得稀疏歷史在分佈內。在推理過程中，整個過去都在固定的預算下運行：一個有界的 KV 緩存由一個基於姿勢索引的地標庫支持，模型從中檢索最接近當前姿勢的地標。一個度量尺度對齊的數據引擎將八個來源——虛幻引擎渲染的飛行穿越、遊戲漫遊和現實世界的影像——放置在一個物理動作尺度上，因此相同的按鍵操作在每個來源中都會使相機移動相同的距離，而回文軌跡提供了記憶訓練所需的重訪證據。分佈匹配的蒸餾限制在 LoRA 適配器內，然後將取樣壓縮為四個步驟：一個主幹同時支持高保真多步模式和實時互動模式，實時串流 704x1280 的視頻，涵蓋寫實、遊戲風格和風格化的世界。在涵蓋行動跟隨、長期回憶和視頻質量的三軸協議下，與六個近期的互動世界模型相比，它達到了最佳的控制保真度（$11.95^\circ$ 旋轉誤差和最佳的相機運動一致性）以及最佳的生成質量；在長達一分鐘的來回回滾（$64$\,s，$384$ 潛變量）中，其固定的 12 片段緩存仍然能夠再生起始視圖——在滑動窗口早已驅逐證據且全 KV 注意力耗盡內存的回滾長度下。
